eyebrow: PROJECT 02 · MACHINE LEARNING, CLUSTERING & DAG COMPILER
title: Trade Bot (Oracle & Wave Y): Leakage-Free ML & Visual Strategy Engine
plainPitch: A hybrid Python + TypeScript ML platform that discovers market regimes with UMAP/HDBSCAN, validates LightGBM models without future-data leakage, and compiles drag-and-drop React Flow graphs into deterministic runtime code.
scopeDisclaimer: Methodology Note: Documents ML validation, clustering, and system parity engineering only. No trading profit claims are made.
diagramHint: Click any block in the ML & execution pipeline below to inspect its interactive visualizer:

nodes.title: Market Lakehouse
nodes.plainSummary: Stores SHA-256 verified Parquet market archives queried by DuckDB, backed by PostgreSQL state and Redis queues.
drawerBullets: Ingests strictly from Binance USD-M Futures & Vision archives into SHA-256 pinned Parquet files queried via DuckDB 1.5.5 and PyArrow 16.1.
Stores engineered feature tables (discovery_dataset_rows) and lifecycle snapshots in PostgreSQL, local caches in SQLite, and job queues in Redis (ioredis).

githubSectionLink.label: View Hybrid Lakehouse Diagram on GitHub

nodes.title: Regime Clustering
nodes.plainSummary: Compresses 30+ price and order-flow metrics via UMAP and discovers natural market regimes with HDBSCAN density clustering.
drawerBullets: Computes 30+ point-in-time features (trend persistence, structural churn, taker buy/sell ratio, volatility compression, BTC/ETH leadership).
Runs StandardScaler strictly on in-sample cutoffs, reduces dimensions with UMAP, clusters with HDBSCAN 0.8.33, and checks stability via Feature Ablation (hl02).

githubSectionLink.label: View UMAP & HDBSCAN Diagram on GitHub

nodes.title: LightGBM + Purged CV
nodes.plainSummary: Trains LightGBM models against Scikit-Learn linear baselines using time-purged splits so future windows never leak.
drawerBullets: Benchmarks depth-constrained LightGBM 4.6 (LGBMClassifier & LGBMRegressor) against Scikit-Learn LogisticRegression baselines and prior rates.
Enforces outcomeAvailableAt < fold_start with a 4-hour PURGE_4H_MS embargo gap and episode grouping (symbol|episodeId) before scoring ROC-AUC and Log-Loss.

githubSectionLink.label: View Purged Walk-Forward Diagram on GitHub

nodes.title: Model Calibration Gate
nodes.plainSummary: Requires tree models to beat calibrated linear baselines on out-of-sample discrimination and probability calibration.
drawerBullets: Evaluates Prior Baseline, Direction-Only Linear, Full Linear (SimpleImputer + StandardScaler + LogisticRegression), and LightGBM side by side.
Includes net-of-cost replay checks accounting for fees, slippage, funding, and drawdown.

nodes.title: React Flow AST Engine
nodes.plainSummary: Compiles visual React Flow strategy graphs through AJV schemas so Backtest, Replay, Paper, and Live run identical code.
nodes.drawerEyebrow: Visual DAG Compiler & Deterministic Execution Parity
drawerBullets: Built a visual editor in React 18, @xyflow/react v12, Dagre, Zustand, and TradingView Lightweight Charts.
Compiles graphs via updateBlockLogicManifest and AJV JSON Schema validation into one TypeScript kernel shared across Backtest, proc204/proc206 Replay, Paper, and Express 5 / CCXT Live execution.

purgedCv.title: How We Prevent ML Data Leakage (Purged Walk-Forward CV)
purgedCv.subtitle: Standard k-fold leaks future outcomes into training. Switch modes to see how our 4-hour purge gap keeps test folds clean.
purgedCv.assertCode: if set(train.group) & set(test.group): raise RuntimeError('episode leakage')
purgedCv.naiveCaption: Future price outcomes overlap inside training splits, creating fake high backtest scores.
purgedCv.purgedCaption: Every training sample finishes strictly before fold_start, separated by a 4-hour purge buffer.
